notes.title: Going Dark 1.4.0 Update Notes
notes.content: [p]This Update Implements 18 Achievements into Going Dark. Launch going dark so that progress achievements you've already earned can be added to your account.[/p]

notes.content: [p]In this update Going Dark receives a Master of Stealth Difficulty for the Cargo Ship Mission.[/p][p] [/p][h1]Gameplay[/h1][list][*][p]Added Master of Stealth Difficulty for the Cargo Ship Mission.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a detection box in the Warehouse Mission[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Quality of Life[/h1][list][*][p]Added Steam Integrated Cloud Saves for progress.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Going Dark Demo 0.3.0 Update Notes
notes.content:
In this update Going Dark receives 4 difficulties to balance the game towards all players liking and add an ultimate challenge for veterans of the stealth genre in the form of the master of stealth difficulty that introduces alternative guard placements!

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Difficulty Settings
[*] AI Improvements
[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved detection meter readability
[*] Improved loading screen
[*] Added signifier for when a checkpoint is reached
[*] Added icon showing where you left your USB drive
[/list]

[h1]Accessibility[/h1]
[list]
[*] Moved option to change icon style of gamepad input prompts into gamepad options
[/list]

notes.title: Going Dark Demo 0.1.2 Patch Notes

notes.title: Going Dark Demo 0.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Guard's now go for the closest light switch after noticing light is off.
[*] Guard can notice a light switch that's off and go turn it on.
[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added option to enable input prompt UI
[*] Made it more clear that after you scrap computer for data you're supposed to remove USB.
[*] The icon for the guard being distracted by a light switch changed from a light bulb to a light switch.
[*] Updated mission select screen.
[*] Removed button prompt on some buttons on keyboard and mouse.
[*] Added an additional indicator for player being detected.
[*] Made guard behaviour indicators more visible.
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] Small Level alterations.
[*] Vsync is now off by default.
[/list]

notes.title: Going Dark Demo is Live
notes.content:
Purchase your train ticket and depart on a mission on board of a night train in the Free [b]Demo[/b] for Going Dark that includes the first level of the full game.

[h1]Live right now on Steam.[/h1]

Big thanks to everyone who's wishlisted the game so far.
